# TheCollinsGaming

> TheCollinsGaming is a League of Legends content creator based on the Oceania (OCE) server, specializing in Garen top lane. Known for consistent Garen OCE ranked climbs and duo queue content, TheCollinsGaming streams live on Kick and Twitch, with daily short-form clips and full match VODs on YouTube.

## Identity

- Name: TheCollinsGaming
- Game: League of Legends
- Champion: Garen (top lane)
- Server: Oceania (OCE)
- Handle: @thecollinsgaming / @thecollinsgaming8 (Instagram, TikTok)

- Kick (primary stream): https://kick.com/thecollinsgaming
